svg.text: One equal tile per state, placed roughly by
geography; not an order. Shades read within one
map only: maps do not share a scale.
Washington, DC (tile DC) is not a state: it sits
apart and is not counted (its line: Section 11.5).
Counts are of the 50 states. Level 0 includes no
law found and a law signed but not yet in force.
Copy rights and sensitive records: Tables 11 and 12
only; the plan does not allow a map of either.
Law read 2026-10-03. Not legal advice: every cell records what a primary legal text said on the date it was read.
Source: Health Record Rights Index, US state layer (data/us-states), SuperTruth.
